how do i keep tension when nothing violent happens

Violence is one way to raise stakes and also the laziest, because it ends the question instead of stretching it.

why are water tanks round instead of square

For a given amount of wall, a circle encloses more space than any other shape, so a round tank holds more litres per kilogram of steel. Corners are also where pressure piles up and cracks tend to start, and a circle simply has none. The same reasoning gives you round pipes and round cans 🛢️. [CHIPS]Compare tank shapes|Why pipes are round|Area of a circle[/CHIPS]

whats the difference between i ate and i have eaten

I ate at four pins the action to a finished moment. I have eaten refuses to name a time, because it is really telling you about now: I am not hungry 🍽️ That is present perfect — past event, present relevance. It is also why I have eaten yesterday sounds off; yesterday is a closed box. Try both with finish my homework.[CHIPS]I have finished|I finished yesterday|More tense pairs[/CHIPS]

how does cutting down a forest change the rainfall

Forests don't just catch rain, they pass it on. why do people use the median for salaries instead of the mean
